map.按北美编号计划（NANP）规则，用区号反查所属州/城市并校验号码格式。: Under North American Numbering Plan (NANP) rules, look up the state or city behind an area code and validate the number's format.
map.：NANP 号码为 NPA-NXX-XXXX 共 10 位，NPA 即 3 位区: : an NANP number follows NPA-NXX-XXXX — 10 digits in all, where the NPA is the 3-digit area code.
map.：区号首位为 2–9；第二、三位不得同为 1（避免与 N11 服务码冲突）。: : the first digit of an area code runs from 2 to 9, and the second and third digits must not both be 1 (that would clash with N11 service codes).
map.：NANP 含美国、加拿大及部分加勒比地区，同一区号可能跨州（overlay）。: : the NANP covers the United States, Canada and parts of the Caribbean, and a single area code may span more than one state (an overlay).
map.：识别来电归属地、校验录入号码是否合法。: : identify where an incoming call comes from, and check whether a number you entered is valid.
map.输入（3 位美国/加拿大区号或电话号码）: Input (3-digit US/Canada area code, or a full phone number)
map.查美国 NPA 区号归属州/城市。: Look up the state or city behind a US NPA area code.
map.客服与风控场景：按来电号码的区号判断大致归属地，辅助识别异地异常登录或骚扰电话；: For support and risk-control work: infer roughly where a caller is based from the area code of their number, which helps flag unusual logins from another region or nuisance calls. Bear in mind that it only pins down the area the code covers, not an exact address.
map.`212` → 纽约市 NY；`415` → 旧金山湾区。: `212` → New York City, NY; `415` → the San Francisco Bay Area.
map.区号会新增吗？: Do new area codes get added?
map.会，号码资源紧张时新增区号。: Yes — new codes are introduced whenever numbering resources run short.
map.查不到某个区号是怎么回事？: Why can't I find a particular area code?
map.可能原因有三：该区号属于新启用的叠加区号（overlay）尚未收录；号码来自加拿: There are three likely reasons: the code may be a newly activated overlay that has not been added yet; the number may come from Canada, the Caribbean or another NANP member (the plan covers far more than the United States); or you entered a non-geographic code such as a toll-free 800/888 or a premium-rate 900.
